description: Allowlist for intentional hardcoded aria-label/placeholder/title/<meta content> strings that bypass the no-restricted-syntax i18n guard in eslint.config.js. Each entry MUST have a non-empty `reason` matching the `-- <reason>` suffix on the corresponding `eslint-disable-next-line no-restricted-syntax -- <reason>` comment. scripts/i18n-allowlist-check.ts enforces structure (via JSON Schema) + drift on CI.
